resources.string: Rebind this device if biometric unlock still fails after password unlock
Enter your original master password to rebind this device. Your vault, password protection and previous recovery material will be kept. This does not enable biometric unlock.
The unlock binding was repaired. Your vault and previous recovery material were kept. You can now enable biometric unlock if it is available.
Repair could not be confirmed. Your vault and previous recovery material were kept. Unlock with your master password and retry later.
Unlock the device with its screen lock, then retry. The existing authentication requirement will be preserved.
Unlock with your master password. If biometric unlock still fails, open Settings → Master password and locking → Repair biometric unlock.
